187std::string jsonQuoted(const std::string &value) {
188 std::string out = "\"";
189 for (const unsigned char ch : value) {
190 switch (ch) {
191 case '\"': out += "\\\""; break;
192 case '\\': out += "\\\\"; break;
193 case '\n': out += "\\n"; break;
194 case '\r': out += "\\r"; break;
195 case '\t': out += "\\t"; break;
196 default:
197 if (ch >= 0x20) out += static_cast<char>(ch);
198 break;
199 }
200 }
201 out += '\"';
202 return out;
203}

206void callScriptHandler(ssq::Function &fn, const std::string &kind, const UIEvent &ev) {
207 HSQUIRRELVM vm = fn.getHandle();
208 if (!vm) return;
209 const SQInteger top = sq_gettop(vm);
210 sq_pushobject(vm, fn.getRaw());
211 sq_pushroottable(vm); // env
212 if (kind == "click") {
213 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_call(vm, 1, SQFalse, SQTrue))) {
214 sq_settop(vm, top);
215 return;
216 }
217 } else {
218 sq_pushstring(vm, kind.c_str(), -1);
219 if (kind == "toggle") sq_pushbool(vm, ev.toggleValue ? SQTrue : SQFalse);
220 else if (kind == "value") sq_pushfloat(vm, ev.floatValue);
221 else sq_pushstring(vm, ev.textValue.c_str(), -1);
222 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_call(vm, 3, SQFalse, SQTrue))) {
223 sq_settop(vm, top);
224 return;
225 }
226 }
227 sq_settop(vm, top);
228}

237const char *kUIComponentScript = R"SQ(
238if (!("_uiComponents" in eve)) eve._uiComponents <- []
239if (!("_nextUIComponentOwner" in eve)) eve._nextUIComponentOwner <- 0
240
241eve._scheduleUIComponent <- function(component) {
242 if (component == null || component._scheduled) return
243 component._scheduled = true
244 eve._uiComponents.append(component)
245}
246
247eve._flushUIComponents <- function() {
248 local pending = eve._uiComponents
249 eve._uiComponents = []
250 foreach (component in pending) {
251 component._scheduled = false
252 if (component._mounted && component._parent == null && component.dirty)
253 component.updateIfDirty()
254 }
255}
256
257::eve_ui_flush_components <- function() {
258 eve._flushUIComponents()
259}
260
261eve.UIComponent <- class {
262 hostName = ""
263 dirty = true
264 forceFull = false
265 props = null
266 state = null
267 _ui = null
268 _parent = null
269 _mounted = false
270 _scheduled = false
271 _children = null
272 _nextChildren = null
273 _keyedChildren = null
274 _eventBindings = null
275 _eventOwner = 0
276
277 constructor(uiInstance = null, initialProps = null) {
278 _ui = uiInstance
279 hostName = ""
280 dirty = true
281 forceFull = false
282 props = initialProps != null ? initialProps : {}
283 state = {}
284 _parent = null
285 _mounted = false
286 _scheduled = false
287 _children = []
288 _nextChildren = []
289 _keyedChildren = {}
290 _eventBindings = []
291 eve._nextUIComponentOwner += 1
292 _eventOwner = eve._nextUIComponentOwner
293 }
294
295 function setUI(uiInstance) { _ui = uiInstance; return this }
296
297 function _applyProps(nextProps, replace, notify) {
298 if (nextProps == null) return this
299 if (replace) props = {}
300 foreach (key, value in nextProps) props.rawset(key, value)
301 if (notify) markDirty()
302 return this
303 }
304
305 function setProps(nextProps, replace = false) {
306 return _applyProps(nextProps, replace, true)
307 }
308
309 function mountAs(name) {
310 hostName = name
311 dirty = true
312 forceFull = true
313 updateIfDirty()
314 return this
315 }
316
317 function setState(patch = null) {
318 if (patch != null) {
319 foreach (key, value in patch) state.rawset(key, value)
320 }
321 markDirty()
322 return this
323 }
324 function markDirty() {
325 dirty = true
326 if (_parent != null && _parent != this) _parent.markDirty()
327 else if (_mounted) eve._scheduleUIComponent(this)
328 return this
329 }
330
331 // Compose a persistent child instance inside this component's active build pass.
332 function renderChild(component, nextProps = null, replaceProps = false) {
333 if (component == null) return null
334 component._parent = this
335 component.setUI(ui())
336 component._applyProps(nextProps, replaceProps, false)
337 _nextChildren.append(component)
338 local firstMount = !component._mounted
339 component._nextChildren = []
340 component.build()
341 component._finishChildPass()
342 component.dirty = false
343 component._mounted = true
344 if (firstMount) component.onMount()
345 else component.onUpdated()
346 return component
347 }
348
349 // Reuse a child component by a stable key. factory is called only for a new key.
350 function renderKeyed(key, factory, nextProps = null, replaceProps = false) {
351 if (key == null) throw "UIComponent renderKeyed requires a key"
352 local component = null
353 if (key in _keyedChildren) component = _keyedChildren[key]
354 else {
355 component = factory()
356 if (component == null) throw "UIComponent renderKeyed factory returned null"
357 _keyedChildren.rawset(key, component)
358 }
359 return renderChild(component, nextProps, replaceProps)
360 }
361
362 function _bindEvent(kind, id, fn) {
363 if (id == null || id == "" || fn == null) return this
364 foreach (binding in _eventBindings) {
365 if (binding.kind == kind && binding.id == id) {
366 binding.fn = fn
367 if (_mounted) _syncEventHandlers()
368 return this
369 }
370 }
371 _eventBindings.append({ kind = kind, id = id, fn = fn })
372 if (_mounted) _syncEventHandlers()
373 return this
374 }
375
376 function bindClick(id, fn) { return _bindEvent("click", id, fn) }
377 function bindChange(id, fn) { return _bindEvent("change", id, fn) }
378
379 function clearEventBindings() {
380 _eventBindings = []
381 ui().componentClearHandlers(_eventOwner)
382 return this
383 }
384
385 function _rootComponent() {
386 local root = this
387 while (root._parent != null && root._parent != root) root = root._parent
388 return root
389 }
390
391 function _syncEventHandlers() {
392 local u = ui()
393 u.componentClearHandlers(_eventOwner)
394 local root = _rootComponent()
395 if (root.hostName == "" || !u.select(root.hostName)) return
396 foreach (binding in _eventBindings) {
397 if (binding.kind == "click") u.componentOnClick(_eventOwner, binding.id, binding.fn)
398 else u.componentOnChange(_eventOwner, binding.id, binding.fn)
399 }
400 }
401
402 function _syncEventTree() {
403 _syncEventHandlers()
404 foreach (child in _children) child._syncEventTree()
405 }
406
407 function _containsChild(items, child) {
408 foreach (candidate in items) {
409 if (candidate == child) return true
410 }
411 return false
412 }
413
414 function _finishChildPass() {
415 foreach (child in _children) {
416 if (!_containsChild(_nextChildren, child)) child._unmountTree()
417 }
418 local staleKeys = []
419 foreach (key, child in _keyedChildren) {
420 if (!_containsChild(_nextChildren, child)) staleKeys.append(key)
421 }
422 foreach (key in staleKeys) delete _keyedChildren[key]
423 _children = _nextChildren
424 _nextChildren = []
425 }
426
427 function _unmountTree() {
428 if (!_mounted) return false
429 foreach (child in _children) child._unmountTree()
430 _children = []
431 _nextChildren = []
432 _mounted = false
433 _scheduled = false
434 dirty = false
435 ui().componentClearHandlers(_eventOwner)
436 onUnmount()
437 _parent = null
438 return true
439 }
440
441 function unmount() {
442 if (!_unmountTree()) return false
443 local u = ui()
444 if (hostName != "" && u.select(hostName)) u.setHostVisible(false)
445 return true
446 }
447
448 // Override in subclass: call this.ui().beginWindow / text / button / end ...
449 function build() {}
450 function onMount() {}
451 function onUpdated() {}
452 function onUnmount() {}
453
454 function ui() {
455 if (_ui != null) return _ui
456 try {
457 if (::ui != null) return ::ui
458 } catch (e) {}
459 _ui = ::eve.UI()
460 return _ui
461 }
462
463 function updateIfDirty() {
464 if (!dirty) return false
465 local firstMount = !_mounted
466 local u = ui()
467 _scheduled = false
468 dirty = false
469 _nextChildren = []
470 u.beginBuild()
471 build()
472 _finishChildPass()
473 local name = hostName
474 if (name == null || name == "") name = "default"
475 hostName = name
476 if (forceFull) {
477 if (!u.mountBuildAs(name)) throw "UIComponent mount failed: " + name
478 forceFull = false
479 } else {
480 if (!u.remountBuildAs(name)) throw "UIComponent remount failed: " + name
481 }
482 _mounted = true
483 u.setHostVisible(true)
484 if (firstMount) onMount()
485 else onUpdated()
486 _syncEventTree()
487 return true
488 }
489
490 function rebuild(force = false) {
491 dirty = true
492 forceFull = force
493 return updateIfDirty()
494 }
495}

499void injectUIComponentClass(ssq::Table &eveTable) {
500 HSQUIRRELVM vm = eveTable.getHandle();
501 const SQInteger top = sq_gettop(vm);
502 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_compilebuffer(vm, kUIComponentScript,
503 static_cast<SQInteger>(std::strlen(kUIComponentScript)),
504 "UIComponent.nut", SQTrue))) {
505 sq_settop(vm, top);
506 return;
507 }
508 sq_pushroottable(vm);
509 sq_call(vm, 1, SQFalse, SQTrue);
510 sq_settop(vm, top);
511}

552bool UI::initBackend() {
553 if (!backend_) backend_ = createImGuiBackend();
554 if (backend_->isInitialized()) return true;
555 auto *win = eve::ModuleManager::getInstance<eve::window::Window>("Window");
556 auto *gfx = eve::ModuleManager::getInstance<eve::graphics::Graphics>("Graphics");
557 if (!win || !gfx) return false;
558 auto *sdlWin = dynamic_cast<eve::window::sdl::Window *>(win);
559 if (!sdlWin) return false;
560 auto *native = static_cast<SDL_Window *>(sdlWin->getHandle());
561 if (!native) return false;
562 const bool ok = backend_->init(native, gfx);
563 if (ok) UISystem::setBackend(*backend_);
564 return ok;
565}

598void UI::dispatchEvents() {
599 // Copy before dispatch: UISystem::dispatchEvents() consumes the pending list.
600 const std::vector<UIEvent> events = UISystem::pendingEvents();
601 UISystem::dispatchEvents();
602 for (const auto &ev : events) {
603 if (!UIHost::resolve(ev.host)) continue;
604 fireScriptHandlers(ev);
605 }
606}
607
608void UI::fireScriptHandlers(const UIEvent &ev) {
609 for (const auto &h : scriptHandlers_) {
610 if (h.hostName != ev.hostName || h.nodeId != ev.nodeId) continue;
611 if (h.kind == "click" && ev.kind == "click") {
612 ssq::Function fn = h.fn;
613 callScriptHandler(fn, "click", ev);
614 } else if (h.kind == ev.kind &&
615 (ev.kind == "toggle" || ev.kind == "value" || ev.kind == "text")) {
616 ssq::Function fn = h.fn;
617 callScriptHandler(fn, ev.kind, ev);
618 }
619 }
620}

622void UI::onClick(const std::string &id, ssq::Function fn) {
623 auto host = resolveSelected();
624 if (!host || id.empty()) return;
625 scriptHandlers_.push_back(ScriptHandler(host->get().getName(), id, "click", std::move(fn)));
626}

628void UI::onChange(const std::string &id, ssq::Function fn) {
629 auto host = resolveSelected();
630 if (!host || id.empty()) return;

681UIHostHandle UI::ensureSelected(const std::string &preferredName) {
682 if (UIHost::resolve(selected_)) return selected_;
683 selected_ = {};
684 if (!preferredName.empty()) {
685 const UIHostHandle h = findHost(preferredName);
686 if (UIHost::resolve(h)) {
687 selected_ = h;
688 return selected_;
689 }
690 selected_ = UIHost::createHost(preferredName);
691 return selected_;
692 }
693 selected_ = UIHost::createHost("default");
694 return selected_;
695}

697UIHostHandle UI::mountAs(const std::string &name, WidgetDesc root) {
698 UIHostHandle handle = findHost(name);
699 auto host = UIHost::resolve(handle);
700 if (!host) {
701 handle = UIHost::createHost(name);
702 host = UIHost::resolve(handle);
703 } else {
704 host->get().setName(name);
705 }
706 if (!host) return {};
707 host->get().setTree(std::move(root));
708 selected_ = handle;
709 return handle;
710}
711
712UIHostHandle UI::mount(WidgetDesc root) {
713 if (auto host = resolveSelected()) {
714 host->get().setTree(std::move(root));
715 return selected_;
716 }
717 return mountAs("default", std::move(root));
718}

720UIHostHandle UI::remount(WidgetDesc root) {

729 return handle;

811namespace {
812
813std::string toLowerCopy(std::string s) {
814 for (char &c : s) {
815 if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = char(c - 'A' + 'a');
816 }
817 return s;
818}
819
820FlexDirection parseFlexDirection(const std::string &direction) {
821 const std::string d = toLowerCopy(direction);
822 if (d == "column" || d == "col" || d == "vertical" || d == "v") return FlexDirection::Column;
823 return FlexDirection::Row;
824}
825
826FlexAlign parseFlexAlign(const std::string &align) {
827 const std::string a = toLowerCopy(align);
828 if (a == "center") return FlexAlign::Center;
829 if (a == "end" || a == "right" || a == "bottom") return FlexAlign::End;
830 if (a == "stretch") return FlexAlign::Stretch;
831 return FlexAlign::Start;
832}
833
834FlexJustify parseFlexJustify(const std::string &justify) {
835 const std::string j = toLowerCopy(justify);
836 if (j == "center") return FlexJustify::Center;
837 if (j == "end" || j == "right" || j == "bottom") return FlexJustify::End;
838 if (j == "spacebetween" || j == "space-between" || j == "between")
839 return FlexJustify::SpaceBetween;
840 if (j == "spacearound" || j == "space-around" || j == "around") return FlexJustify::SpaceAround;
841 return FlexJustify::Start;
842}
843
844OverflowMode parseOverflowMode(const std::string &overflow) {
845 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(overflow);
846 if (value == "clip" || value == "hidden") return OverflowMode::Clip;
847 if (value == "scroll" || value == "auto") return OverflowMode::Scroll;
848 return OverflowMode::Visible;
849}
850
851FocusMode parseFocusMode(const std::string &mode) {
852 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(mode);
853 if (value == "none") return FocusMode::None;
854 if (value == "click") return FocusMode::Click;
855 return FocusMode::All;
856}
857
858MouseFilter parseMouseFilter(const std::string &filter) {
859 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(filter);
860 if (value == "pass") return MouseFilter::Pass;
861 if (value == "ignore") return MouseFilter::Ignore;
862 return MouseFilter::Stop;
863}
864
865ThemePreset parseThemePreset(const std::string &theme) {
866 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(theme);
867 if (value == "dark") return ThemePreset::Dark;
868 if (value == "light") return ThemePreset::Light;
869 return ThemePreset::Inherit;
870}
871
872AccessibilityRole parseAccessibilityRole(const std::string &role) {
873 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(role);
874 if (value == "button") return AccessibilityRole::Button;
875 if (value == "checkbox") return AccessibilityRole::Checkbox;
876 if (value == "slider") return AccessibilityRole::Slider;
877 if (value == "text") return AccessibilityRole::Text;
878 if (value == "textinput" || value == "text-input") return AccessibilityRole::TextInput;
879 if (value == "list") return AccessibilityRole::List;
880 if (value == "listitem" || value == "list-item") return AccessibilityRole::ListItem;
881 if (value == "menu") return AccessibilityRole::Menu;
882 if (value == "menuitem" || value == "menu-item") return AccessibilityRole::MenuItem;
883 if (value == "progress") return AccessibilityRole::Progress;
884 if (value == "region") return AccessibilityRole::Region;
885 if (value == "tab") return AccessibilityRole::Tab;
886 if (value == "window") return AccessibilityRole::Window;
887 return AccessibilityRole::Auto;
888}
889
890bool parseFocusDirection(const std::string &direction, FocusDirection *out) {
891 if (!out) return false;
892 const std::string value = toLowerCopy(direction);
893 if (value == "next") *out = FocusDirection::Next;
894 else if (value == "previous" || value == "prev") *out = FocusDirection::Previous;
895 else if (value == "left") *out = FocusDirection::Left;
896 else if (value == "right") *out = FocusDirection::Right;
897 else if (value == "up") *out = FocusDirection::Up;
898 else if (value == "down") *out = FocusDirection::Down;
899 else return false;
900 return true;
901}
902
903} // namespace

1023void UI::addCombo(const std::string &label, const std::string &options, int selected,
1024 const std::string &id) {
1025 std::vector<std::string> items;
1026 size_t start = 0;
1027 while (start <= options.size()) {
1028 const size_t end = options.find('\n', start);
1029 items.push_back(options.substr(start, end == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos
1030 : end - start));
1031 if (end == std::string::npos) break;
1032 start = end + 1;
1033 }
1034 currentParent().children.push_back(combo(label, items, selected, id));
1035}

1286bool UI::mountBuild() {
1287 if (!buildComplete()) return false;
1288 const UIHostHandle handle = remount(std::move(builtRoot_));

1295bool UI::mountBuildAs(const std::string &name) {
1296 if (!buildComplete()) return false;
1297 const UIHostHandle handle = mountAs(name, std::move(builtRoot_));
1298 if (!UIHost::resolve(handle)) return false;
1299 hasBuiltRoot_ = false;
1300 builtRoot_ = WidgetDesc{};
1301 return true;
1302}
1303
1304bool UI::remountBuildAs(const std::string &name) {
1305 if (!buildComplete()) return false;
1306 UIHostHandle h = findHost(name);
1307 if (!UIHost::resolve(h)) h = UIHost::createHost(name);
1308 auto host = UIHost::resolve(h);
1309 if (!host) return false;
1310 host->get().setTreeReconcile(std::move(builtRoot_));
1311 selected_ = h;
1312 hasBuiltRoot_ = false;
1313 builtRoot_ = WidgetDesc{};
1314 return true;
1315}

1471bool UI::setImageNinePatchFile(const std::string &id, const std::string &path) {
1472 auto host = resolveSelected();
1473 if (!host) return false;
1474 auto n = host->get().findById(id);
1475 if (!n || (n->get().type != NodeType::Image && n->get().type != NodeType::ImageButton &&
1476 n->get().type != NodeType::NinePatchPanel))
1477 return false;
1478 auto *asset = loadNinePatch(path);
1479 if (!asset) return false;
1480 n->get().textureId = asset->textureId;
1481 n->get().borderL = float(asset->info.borderLeft);
1482 n->get().borderT = float(asset->info.borderTop);
1483 n->get().borderR = float(asset->info.borderRight);
1484 n->get().borderB = float(asset->info.borderBottom);
1485 if (n->get().type == NodeType::NinePatchPanel) {
1486 n->get().paddingL = float(asset->info.paddingLeft);
1487 n->get().paddingT = float(asset->info.paddingTop);
1488 n->get().paddingR = float(asset->info.paddingRight);
1489 n->get().paddingB = float(asset->info.paddingBottom);
1490 }
1491 return true;
1492}
1493
1494UI::NinePatchResource *UI::loadNinePatch(const std::string &path) {
1495 if (auto found = ninePatches_.find(path); found != ninePatches_.end())
1496 return &found->second;
1497 auto *images = eve::ModuleManager::getInstance<eve::image::Image>("Image");
1498 auto *graphics = eve::ModuleManager::getInstance<eve::graphics::Graphics>("Graphics");
1499 if (!images || !graphics) return nullptr;
1500 try {
1501 // The provider hands back a cache-owned ImageData; the pin keeps it alive
1502 // while the nine-patch border is measured and stripped.
1503 eve::image::ImageData *source = images->newImageDataFromFile(path);
1504 if (source == nullptr) return nullptr;
1505 auto sourcePin = eve::ResourceManager::getInstance().pin(source);
1506 if (!sourcePin.ok()) return nullptr;
1507 eve::ResourcePin keepAlive = std::move(sourcePin).takeValue();
1508 // The pin is the authority from here on; the borrowed pointer may have gone stale
1509 // before the pin was taken.
1510 source = static_cast<eve::image::ImageData *>(keepAlive.get());
1511 NinePatchResource resource;
1512 std::string error;
1513 if (!parseNinePatch(*source, resource.info, &error)) {
1514 std::fprintf(stderr, "[ui] invalid .9.png '%s': %s\n", path.c_str(),
1515 error.c_str());
1516 return nullptr;
1517 }
1518 auto cropped = stripNinePatchBorder(*source);
1519 if (!cropped) return nullptr;
1520 resource.texture = graphics->newTexture(cropped.get());
1521 if (!resource.texture) return nullptr;
1522 resource.textureId = registerTexture(resource.texture);
1523 if (resource.textureId == 0) {
1524 graphics->releaseTexture(resource.texture);
1525 return nullptr;
1526 }
1527 auto inserted = ninePatches_.emplace(path, std::move(resource));
1528 return &inserted.first->second;
1529 } catch (const std::exception &e) {
1530 std::fprintf(stderr, "[ui] failed to load .9.png '%s': %s\n", path.c_str(), e.what());
1531 return nullptr;
1532 }
1533}
1534
1535void UI::releaseNinePatches() {
1536 auto *graphics = eve::ModuleManager::getInstance<eve::graphics::Graphics>("Graphics");
1537 for (auto &[path, resource] : ninePatches_) {
1538 (void)path;
1539 if (backend_ && resource.textureId != 0)
1540 backend_->unregisterTexture(resource.textureId);
1541 if (graphics && resource.texture) graphics->releaseTexture(resource.texture);
1542 }
1543 ninePatches_.clear();
1544}

1716std::string UI::consumeDrop() {
1717 auto drop = UISystem::consumeDrop();
1718 if (!drop) return {};
1719 lastDropType_ = std::move(drop->payloadType);
1720 lastDropText_ = std::move(drop->payloadText);
1721 lastDropSource_ = drop->sourceHostName.empty()
1722 ? std::string{}
1723 : drop->sourceHostName + "/" + drop->sourceNodeId;
1724 lastDropOrigin_ = drop->origin == DragDropOrigin::OperatingSystemFile ? "os-file"
1725 : "internal";
1726 return drop->targetHostName.empty() ? drop->targetNodeId
1727 : drop->targetHostName + "/" + drop->targetNodeId;
1728}

1820std::string UI::getLayoutDiagnostics() const {
1821 auto host = resolveSelected();
1822 if (!host) return "{\"nodes\":[]}";
1823 std::ostringstream out;
1824 out << "{\"host\":" << jsonQuoted(host->get().getName()) << ",\"nodes\":[";
1825 bool first = true;
1826 for (const UINode &node : host->get().tree()->nodes) {
1827 if (!first) out << ',';
1828 first = false;
1829 out << "{\"id\":" << jsonQuoted(node.id) << ",\"width\":" << node.measuredW
1830 << ",\"height\":" << node.measuredH << ",\"overflowX\":"
1831 << node.layoutOverflowX << ",\"overflowY\":" << node.layoutOverflowY << '}';
1832 }
1833 out << "]}";
1834 return out.str();
1835}
1836
1837std::string UI::getAccessibilitySnapshot() const {
1838 auto host = resolveSelected();
1839 if (!host) return "{\"nodes\":[]}";
1840 std::ostringstream out;
1841 out << "{\"host\":" << jsonQuoted(host->get().getName()) << ",\"nodes\":[";
1842 bool first = true;
1843 for (const UINode &node : host->get().tree()->nodes) {
1844 if (node.accessibilityRole == AccessibilityRole::Auto &&
1845 node.accessibilityName.empty())
1846 continue;
1847 if (!first) out << ',';
1848 first = false;
1849 out << "{\"id\":" << jsonQuoted(node.id) << ",\"role\":"
1850 << static_cast<int>(node.accessibilityRole) << ",\"name\":"
1851 << jsonQuoted(node.accessibilityName) << ",\"description\":"
1852 << jsonQuoted(node.accessibilityDescription) << ",\"enabled\":"
1853 << (node.enabled ? "true" : "false") << ",\"focused\":"
1854 << (node.focused ? "true" : "false") << '}';
1855 }
1856 out << "]}";
1857 return out.str();
1858}

1860#if !(defined(EVENGINE_WEBGPU) && defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__))
1861std::string UI::saveTreeJson() const {
1862 auto host = resolveSelected();
1863 if (!host) return "{}";
1864 auto t = host->get().tree();
1865 Poco::JSON::Object root;
1866 root.set("schema", "eve.ui.tree");
1867 root.set("version", 4);
1868 root.set("host", host->get().getName());
1869 if (t->root >= 0) nodeToJson(*t, t->nodes[size_t(t->root)], root);
1870 std::ostringstream oss;
1871 Poco::JSON::Stringifier::stringify(root, oss, 1);
1872 return oss.str();
1873}

1895// WebGPU trims Poco. Use EVCommon's owning Value/JSON path so UI assets retain
1896// their portable core rather than degrading to a silent no-op.
1897std::string UI::saveTreeJson() const {
1898 auto host = resolveSelected();
1899 if (!host) return "{}";
1900 static const char *types[] = {
1901 "window", "text", "button", "sameLine", "group", "separator", "checkbox",
1902 "slider", "progress", "inputText", "collapsingHeader", "child", "flex", "spacer",
1903 "image", "imageButton", "combo", "scrollList", "viewport", "searchField", "switch",
1904 "badge", "card", "sectionHeader", "menuBar", "menu", "menuItem", "toolbar", "toolbox",
1905 "sidebar", "statusBar", "splitPane", "ninePatchPanel", "colorPalette", "grid"};
1906 const auto tree = host->get().tree();
1907 std::function<eve::Value(int)> encode = [&](int index) -> eve::Value {
1908 const UINode &n = tree->nodes[size_t(index)];
1909 eve::Value node = eve::Value::object({});
1910 const int typeIndex = static_cast<int>(n.type);
1911 node.set("type", typeIndex >= 0 && typeIndex < int(std::size(types)) ? types[typeIndex]
1912 : "text");
1913 if (!n.id.empty()) node.set("id", n.id);
1914 if (!n.key.empty()) node.set("key", n.key);
1915 if (!n.text.empty()) node.set("text", n.text);
1916 if (!n.valueText.empty()) node.set("valueText", n.valueText);
1917 if (!n.tooltip.empty()) node.set("tooltip", n.tooltip);
1918 if (!n.styleClass.empty()) node.set("styleClass", n.styleClass);
1919 node.set("visible", n.visible);
1920 node.set("enabled", n.enabled);
1921 node.set("checked", n.checked);
1922 node.set("value", n.value);
1923 node.set("minValue", n.minValue);
1924 node.set("maxValue", n.maxValue);
1925 node.set("sizeX", n.sizeX);
1926 node.set("sizeY", n.sizeY);
1927 node.set("flexDirection", n.flexDirection == FlexDirection::Column ? "column" : "row");
1928 node.set("alignItems", int(n.alignItems));
1929 node.set("justifyContent", int(n.justifyContent));
1930 node.set("gap", n.gap);
1931 node.set("columnGap", n.columnGap);
1932 node.set("rowGap", n.rowGap);
1933 node.set("flexGrow", n.flexGrow);
1934 node.set("flexShrink", n.flexShrink);
1935 node.set("flexBasis", n.flexBasis);
1936 node.set("alignSelf", n.alignSelf);
1937 node.set("aspectRatio", n.aspectRatio);
1938 node.set("flexWrap", n.flexWrap == FlexWrap::Wrap ? "wrap" : "nowrap");
1939 node.set("overflow", int(n.overflow));
1940 node.set("gridColumns", n.gridColumns);
1941 node.set("gridColumnSpan", n.gridColumnSpan);
1942 node.set("accessibilityRole", int(n.accessibilityRole));
1943 node.set("accessibilityName", n.accessibilityName);
1944 node.set("accessibilityDescription", n.accessibilityDescription);
1945 eve::Value children = eve::Value::array({});
1946 for (int child = n.firstChild; child >= 0;
1947 child = tree->nodes[size_t(child)].nextSibling)
1948 children.pushBack(encode(child));
1949 node.set("children", std::move(children));
1950 return node;
1951 };
1952 eve::Value root = tree->root >= 0 ? encode(tree->root) : eve::Value::object({});
1953 root.set("schema", "eve.ui.tree");
1954 root.set("version", 4);
1955 root.set("host", host->get().getName());
1956 auto encoded = eve::json::stringify(root);
1957 return encoded.ok() ? std::move(encoded).takeValue() : "{}";
1958}

1960bool UI::loadTreeJson(const std::string &text) {
1961 auto host = resolveSelected();
1962 if (!host || text.empty()) return false;
1963 std::string error;
1964 const eve::json::Document document = eve::json::Document::parse(text, &error);
1965 const eve::json::Value root = document.root();
1966 if (!document.valid() || !root.isObject()) return false;
1967 if (root.has("schema") && root.getString("schema") != "eve.ui.tree") return false;
1968 const int version = root.getInt("version", 1);
1969 if (version < 1 || version > 4) return false;
1970 static const char *types[] = {
1971 "window", "text", "button", "sameLine", "group", "separator", "checkbox",
1972 "slider", "progress", "inputText", "collapsingHeader", "child", "flex", "spacer",
1973 "image", "imageButton", "combo", "scrollList", "viewport", "searchField", "switch",
1974 "badge", "card", "sectionHeader", "menuBar", "menu", "menuItem", "toolbar", "toolbox",
1975 "sidebar", "statusBar", "splitPane", "ninePatchPanel", "colorPalette", "grid"};
1976 std::function<WidgetDesc(eve::json::Value)> decode = [&](eve::json::Value value) {
1977 WidgetDesc node;
1978 const std::string type = value.getString("type", "text");
1979 for (int i = 0; i < int(std::size(types)); ++i)
1980 if (type == types[i]) node.type = static_cast<NodeType>(i);
1981 node.id = value.getString("id");
1982 node.key = value.getString("key");
1983 node.text = value.getString("text");
1984 node.valueText = value.getString("valueText");
1985 node.tooltip = value.getString("tooltip");
1986 node.styleClass = value.getString("styleClass");
1987 node.visible = value.getBool("visible", true);
1988 node.enabled = value.getBool("enabled", true);
1989 node.checked = value.getBool("checked", false);
1990 node.value = value.getFloat("value");
1991 node.minValue = value.getFloat("minValue");
1992 node.maxValue = value.getFloat("maxValue", 1.f);
1993 node.sizeX = value.getFloat("sizeX");
1994 node.sizeY = value.getFloat("sizeY");
1995 node.flexDirection = value.getString("flexDirection") == "column" ? FlexDirection::Column
1996 : FlexDirection::Row;
1997 node.alignItems = static_cast<FlexAlign>(value.getInt("alignItems"));
1998 node.justifyContent = static_cast<FlexJustify>(value.getInt("justifyContent"));
1999 node.gap = value.getFloat("gap", -1.f);
2000 node.columnGap = value.getFloat("columnGap", -1.f);
2001 node.rowGap = value.getFloat("rowGap", -1.f);
2002 node.flexGrow = value.getFloat("flexGrow");
2003 node.flexShrink = value.getFloat("flexShrink", 1.f);
2004 node.flexBasis = value.getFloat("flexBasis", -1.f);
2005 node.alignSelf = value.getInt("alignSelf", -1);
2006 node.aspectRatio = value.getFloat("aspectRatio");
2007 node.flexWrap = value.getString("flexWrap") == "wrap" ? FlexWrap::Wrap : FlexWrap::NoWrap;
2008 node.overflow = static_cast<OverflowMode>(value.getInt("overflow"));
2009 node.gridColumns = std::max(1, value.getInt("gridColumns", 1));
2010 node.gridColumnSpan = std::max(1, value.getInt("gridColumnSpan", 1));
2011 node.accessibilityRole = static_cast<AccessibilityRole>(value.getInt("accessibilityRole"));
2012 node.accessibilityName = value.getString("accessibilityName");
2013 node.accessibilityDescription = value.getString("accessibilityDescription");
2014 const eve::json::Value children = value.get("children");
2015 for (size_t i = 0; i < children.size(); ++i)
2016 if (children.at(i).isObject()) node.children.push_back(decode(children.at(i)));
2017 return node;
2018 };
2019 host->get().setTree(decode(root));
2020 return true;
2021}

2165void nodeToJson(const UIHost::Tree &tree, const UINode &n, Poco::JSON::Object &o) {
2166 o.set("type", nodeTypeName(n.type));
2167 if (!n.id.empty()) o.set("id", n.id);
2168 if (!n.key.empty()) o.set("key", n.key);
2169 if (!n.text.empty()) o.set("text", n.text);
2170 if (!n.valueText.empty()) o.set("valueText", n.valueText);
2171 if (!n.tooltip.empty()) o.set("tooltip", n.tooltip);
2172 if (!n.visible) o.set("visible", false);
2173 if (!n.enabled) o.set("enabled", false);
2174 if (n.focusMode != FocusMode::All)
2175 o.set("focusMode", n.focusMode == FocusMode::None ? "none" : "click");
2176 if (n.mouseFilter != MouseFilter::Stop)
2177 o.set("mouseFilter", n.mouseFilter == MouseFilter::Pass ? "pass" : "ignore");
2178 if (n.themePreset != ThemePreset::Inherit)
2179 o.set("theme", n.themePreset == ThemePreset::Dark ? "dark" : "light");
2180 if (!n.styleClass.empty()) o.set("styleClass", n.styleClass);
2181 if (n.tabIndex != 0) o.set("tabIndex", n.tabIndex);
2182 if (!n.focusPrevious.empty()) o.set("focusPrevious", n.focusPrevious);
2183 if (!n.focusNext.empty()) o.set("focusNext", n.focusNext);
2184 if (!n.focusLeft.empty()) o.set("focusLeft", n.focusLeft);
2185 if (!n.focusRight.empty()) o.set("focusRight", n.focusRight);
2186 if (!n.focusUp.empty()) o.set("focusUp", n.focusUp);
2187 if (!n.focusDown.empty()) o.set("focusDown", n.focusDown);
2188 if (n.accessibilityRole != AccessibilityRole::Auto) {
2189 const char *role = "auto";
2190 switch (n.accessibilityRole) {
2191 case AccessibilityRole::Button: role = "button"; break;
2192 case AccessibilityRole::Checkbox: role = "checkbox"; break;
2193 case AccessibilityRole::Slider: role = "slider"; break;
2194 case AccessibilityRole::Text: role = "text"; break;
2195 case AccessibilityRole::TextInput: role = "text-input"; break;
2196 case AccessibilityRole::List: role = "list"; break;
2197 case AccessibilityRole::ListItem: role = "list-item"; break;
2198 case AccessibilityRole::Menu: role = "menu"; break;
2199 case AccessibilityRole::MenuItem: role = "menu-item"; break;
2200 case AccessibilityRole::Progress: role = "progress"; break;
2201 case AccessibilityRole::Region: role = "region"; break;
2202 case AccessibilityRole::Tab: role = "tab"; break;
2203 case AccessibilityRole::Window: role = "window"; break;
2204 case AccessibilityRole::Auto: break;
2205 }
2206 o.set("accessibilityRole", role);
2207 }
2208 if (!n.accessibilityName.empty()) o.set("accessibilityName", n.accessibilityName);
2209 if (!n.accessibilityDescription.empty())
2210 o.set("accessibilityDescription", n.accessibilityDescription);
2211 if (n.dragSource) {
2212 o.set("dragSource", true);
2213 o.set("dragPayloadType", n.dragPayloadType);
2214 o.set("dragPayloadText", n.dragPayloadText);
2215 }
2216 if (n.dropTarget) {
2217 o.set("dropTarget", true);
2218 o.set("acceptedDropType", n.acceptedDropType);
2219 }
2220 if (n.checked) o.set("checked", true);
2221 if (!n.open) o.set("open", false);
2222 if (n.value != 0.f) o.set("value", n.value);
2223 if (n.minValue != 0.f) o.set("minValue", n.minValue);
2224 if (n.maxValue != 1.f) o.set("maxValue", n.maxValue);
2225 if (n.sizeX != 0.f) o.set("sizeX", n.sizeX);
2226 if (n.sizeY != 0.f) o.set("sizeY", n.sizeY);
2227 if (n.marginL != 0.f || n.marginT != 0.f || n.marginR != 0.f || n.marginB != 0.f)
2228 o.set("margin", Poco::Dynamic::Array({n.marginL, n.marginT, n.marginR, n.marginB}));
2229 if (n.paddingL != 0.f || n.paddingT != 0.f || n.paddingR != 0.f || n.paddingB != 0.f)
2230 o.set("padding", Poco::Dynamic::Array({n.paddingL, n.paddingT, n.paddingR, n.paddingB}));
2231 if (n.minSizeX != 0.f) o.set("minSizeX", n.minSizeX);
2232 if (n.minSizeY != 0.f) o.set("minSizeY", n.minSizeY);
2233 if (n.maxSizeX != 0.f) o.set("maxSizeX", n.maxSizeX);
2234 if (n.maxSizeY != 0.f) o.set("maxSizeY", n.maxSizeY);
2235 if (n.percentW != 0.f) o.set("percentW", n.percentW);
2236 if (n.percentH != 0.f) o.set("percentH", n.percentH);
2237 if (n.aspectRatio > 0.f) o.set("aspectRatio", n.aspectRatio);
2238 if (n.absolute) {
2239 o.set("absolute", true);
2240 o.set("anchorX", n.anchorX);
2241 o.set("anchorY", n.anchorY);
2242 o.set("posX", n.posX);
2243 o.set("posY", n.posY);
2244 }
2245 if (n.wrapWidth != 0.f) o.set("wrapWidth", n.wrapWidth);
2246 if (n.flexDirection != FlexDirection::Row)
2247 o.set("flexDirection", n.flexDirection == FlexDirection::Column ? "column" : "row");
2248 if (n.alignItems != FlexAlign::Start) o.set("alignItems", int(n.alignItems));
2249 if (n.justifyContent != FlexJustify::Start) o.set("justifyContent", int(n.justifyContent));
2250 if (n.gap >= 0.f) o.set("gap", n.gap);
2251 if (n.flexGrow != 0.f) o.set("flexGrow", n.flexGrow);
2252 if (n.flexShrink != 1.f) o.set("flexShrink", n.flexShrink);
2253 if (n.flexBasis >= 0.f) o.set("flexBasis", n.flexBasis);
2254 if (n.alignSelf >= 0) o.set("alignSelf", n.alignSelf);
2255 if (n.columnGap >= 0.f) o.set("columnGap", n.columnGap);
2256 if (n.rowGap >= 0.f) o.set("rowGap", n.rowGap);
2257 if (n.flexWrap == FlexWrap::Wrap) o.set("flexWrap", "wrap");
2258 if (n.overflow != OverflowMode::Visible) o.set("overflow", int(n.overflow));
2259 if (n.type == NodeType::Grid) o.set("gridColumns", n.gridColumns);
2260 if (n.gridColumnSpan != 1) o.set("gridColumnSpan", n.gridColumnSpan);
2261 if (n.type == NodeType::ColorPalette || n.tintR != 1.f || n.tintG != 1.f || n.tintB != 1.f ||
2262 n.tintA != 1.f)
2263 o.set("tint", Poco::Dynamic::Array({n.tintR, n.tintG, n.tintB, n.tintA}));
2264 if (n.borderL != 0.f || n.borderT != 0.f || n.borderR != 0.f || n.borderB != 0.f)
2265 o.set("border", Poco::Dynamic::Array({n.borderL, n.borderT, n.borderR, n.borderB}));
2266 if (n.cornerRadius != 0.f) o.set("cornerRadius", n.cornerRadius);
2267 if (n.uv0x != 0.f || n.uv0y != 0.f || n.uv1x != 1.f || n.uv1y != 1.f)
2268 o.set("uv", Poco::Dynamic::Array({n.uv0x, n.uv0y, n.uv1x, n.uv1y}));
2269
2270 Poco::JSON::Array children;
2271 for (int c = n.firstChild; c >= 0; c = tree.nodes[size_t(c)].nextSibling) {
2272 Poco::JSON::Object child;
2273 nodeToJson(tree, tree.nodes[size_t(c)], child);
2274 children.add(child);
2275 }
2276 if (children.size() > 0) o.set("children", children);
2277}

2287void applyCommonFields(WidgetDesc &d, const Poco::JSON::Object &o) {
2288 if (o.has("id")) d.id = o.getValue<std::string>("id");
2289 if (o.has("key")) d.key = o.getValue<std::string>("key");
2290 if (o.has("text")) d.text = o.getValue<std::string>("text");
2291 if (o.has("valueText")) d.valueText = o.getValue<std::string>("valueText");
2292 if (o.has("tooltip")) d.tooltip = o.getValue<std::string>("tooltip");
2293 if (o.has("visible")) d.visible = o.getValue<bool>("visible");
2294 if (o.has("enabled")) d.enabled = o.getValue<bool>("enabled");
2295 if (o.has("focusMode"))
2296 d.focusMode = parseFocusMode(o.getValue<std::string>("focusMode"));
2297 if (o.has("mouseFilter"))
2298 d.mouseFilter = parseMouseFilter(o.getValue<std::string>("mouseFilter"));
2299 if (o.has("theme"))
2300 d.themePreset = parseThemePreset(o.getValue<std::string>("theme"));
2301 if (o.has("styleClass")) d.styleClass = o.getValue<std::string>("styleClass");
2302 if (o.has("tabIndex")) d.tabIndex = int(fnum(o.get("tabIndex")));
2303 if (o.has("focusPrevious"))
2304 d.focusPrevious = o.getValue<std::string>("focusPrevious");
2305 if (o.has("focusNext")) d.focusNext = o.getValue<std::string>("focusNext");
2306 if (o.has("focusLeft")) d.focusLeft = o.getValue<std::string>("focusLeft");
2307 if (o.has("focusRight")) d.focusRight = o.getValue<std::string>("focusRight");
2308 if (o.has("focusUp")) d.focusUp = o.getValue<std::string>("focusUp");
2309 if (o.has("focusDown")) d.focusDown = o.getValue<std::string>("focusDown");
2310 if (o.has("accessibilityRole"))
2311 d.accessibilityRole =
2312 parseAccessibilityRole(o.getValue<std::string>("accessibilityRole"));
2313 if (o.has("accessibilityName"))
2314 d.accessibilityName = o.getValue<std::string>("accessibilityName");
2315 if (o.has("accessibilityDescription"))
2316 d.accessibilityDescription =

2415WidgetDesc descFromJson(const Poco::JSON::Object &o) {
2416 WidgetDesc d;
2417 d.type = nodeTypeFromName(o.optValue<std::string>("type", "text"));
2418 applyCommonFields(d, o);
2419 if (o.has("children")) {
2420 const Poco::JSON::Array::Ptr children = o.getArray("children");
2421 for (size_t i = 0; i < children->size(); ++i) {
2422 const Poco::JSON::Object::Ptr child =
2423 children->getObject(static_cast<unsigned int>(i));
2424 if (child) d.children.push_back(descFromJson(*child));
2425 }
2426 }
2427 return d;
2428}

2471bool UI::inspectSetPickHandler(ssq::Function fn) {
2472 Runtime *rt = ModuleManager::runtime();
2473 if (!rt) return false;
2474 HSQUIRRELVM squirrel = rt->handle();
2475 const SQInteger top = sq_gettop(squirrel);
2476 sq_pushroottable(squirrel);
2477 sq_pushstring(squirrel, "eve", -1);
2478 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_get(squirrel, -2)) ||
2479 sq_gettype(squirrel, -1) != OT_TABLE) {
2480 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2481 return false;
2482 }
2483 sq_pushstring(squirrel, "_inspectorPickHandler", -1);
2484 sq_pushobject(squirrel, fn.getRaw());
2485 sq_newslot(squirrel, -3, SQFalse);
2486 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2487 return true;
2488}
2489
2490ssq::Object UI::callPickHandler() {
2491 Runtime *rt = ModuleManager::runtime();
2492 if (!rt) return {};
2493 HSQUIRRELVM squirrel = rt->handle();
2494 const SQInteger top = sq_gettop(squirrel);
2495 sq_pushroottable(squirrel);
2496 sq_pushstring(squirrel, "eve", -1);
2497 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_get(squirrel, -2)) ||
2498 sq_gettype(squirrel, -1) != OT_TABLE) {
2499 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2500 return {};
2501 }
2502 sq_pushstring(squirrel, "_inspectorPickHandler", -1);
2503 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_get(squirrel, -2)) ||
2504 (sq_gettype(squirrel, -1) != OT_CLOSURE &&
2505 sq_gettype(squirrel, -1) != OT_NATIVECLOSURE)) {
2506 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2507 return {};
2508 }
2509 sq_pushroottable(squirrel); // environment
2510 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_call(squirrel, 1, SQTrue, SQTrue))) {
2511 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2512 return {};
2513 }
2514 if (sq_gettype(squirrel, -1) != OT_INSTANCE) {
2515 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2516 return {};
2517 }
2518 ssq::Object out(squirrel);
2519 sq_getstackobj(squirrel, -1, &out.getRaw());
2520 sq_addref(squirrel, &out.getRaw());
2521 sq_settop(squirrel, top);
2522 return out;
2523}

2531 return inspector_->inspectObject(picked);

2540const char *propertyKindName(property_access::PropertyKind kind) {
2541 using property_access::PropertyKind;
2542 switch (kind) {
2543 case PropertyKind::Auto: return "auto";
2544 case PropertyKind::Bool: return "bool";
2545 case PropertyKind::Integer: return "integer";
2546 case PropertyKind::Number: return "number";
2547 case PropertyKind::String: return "string";
2548 case PropertyKind::Enum: return "enum";
2549 case PropertyKind::Color: return "color";
2550 case PropertyKind::Vec2: return "vec2";
2551 case PropertyKind::Vec3: return "vec3";
2552 case PropertyKind::Vec4: return "vec4";
2553 case PropertyKind::AssetRef: return "assetRef";
2554 case PropertyKind::ObjectRef: return "objectRef";
2555 case PropertyKind::Struct: return "struct";
2556 case PropertyKind::Array: return "array";
2557 case PropertyKind::Map: return "map";
2558 case PropertyKind::Action: return "action";
2559 case PropertyKind::ReadOnlyText: return "readOnlyText";
2560 }
2561 return "auto";
2562}

2565
2566ssq::Object UI::propertySchema(ssq::Object instance) {
2567 Runtime *runtime = ModuleManager::runtime();
2568 if (!runtime) return ssq::Object();
2569 if (instance.getType() != ssq::Type::INSTANCE) return ssq::Object(runtime->handle());
2570 property_access::ReflectedPropertyModel model(*runtime, instance);
2571 ssq::VM &vm = runtime->vm();
2572 ssq::Table out = vm.newTable();
2573 out.set("typeId", model.schema().typeId);
2574 out.set("version", static_cast<int>(model.schema().version));
2575 ssq::Array properties = vm.newArray();
2576 for (const property_access::PropertyDescriptor &property : model.schema().properties) {
2577 ssq::Table entry = vm.newTable();
2578 entry.set("path", property.path);
2579 entry.set("kind", std::string(propertyKindName(property.kind)));
2580 entry.set("displayName", property.displayName);
2581 entry.set("description", property.description);
2582 entry.set("category", property.category);
2583 entry.set("readOnly", property_access::hasFlag(property.flags, property_access::PropertyFlag::ReadOnly));
2584 entry.set("presenterHint", property.presenterHint);
2585 entry.set("units", property.numeric.units);
2586 if (property.numeric.minimum) entry.set("min", *property.numeric.minimum);
2587 if (property.numeric.maximum) entry.set("max", *property.numeric.maximum);
2588 if (property.numeric.step) entry.set("step", *property.numeric.step);
2589 ssq::Array choices = vm.newArray();
2590 for (const std::string &choice : property.choices) choices.push(choice);
2591 entry.set("choices", choices);
2592 properties.push(entry);
2593 }
2594 out.set("properties", properties);
2595 return out;
2596}
